translations.literal: In the first month of Taining 3 of Emperor Ming Spark-Delight moved retrograde into the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming’s Taining 3 first month retrograded Mars through the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning; the king finds it ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: The interpretation couples warfare with sovereign peril.

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: The intercalary eighth month killed the emperor.

sentences.zh: 後二年，蘇峻反，攻焚宮室，太后以憂逼崩，天子幽劫于石頭城，遠近兵亂，至四年乃息。

translations.literal: Two years later Su Jun rebelled, attacked and burned the palace halls; the empress dowager died of grief and alarm; the Son of Heaven was held hostage at Stone Fortress City; arms convulsed far and near until quiet returned only in the fourth year.
translations.idiomatic: Two years on Su Jun torched the palace, the empress dowager died of shock, the emperor languished at Stone City, and turmoil raged until year four.

sentences.zh: 成帝咸和六年正月丙辰，月入南斗。

translations.literal: On bingchen in the first month of Xianhe 6 the Moon entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Cheng’s Xianhe 6 first month bingchen placed the moon in the Dipper.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops.
translations.idiomatic: Arms will stir.

sentences.zh: 」是月，石勒殺略婁、武進二縣人。

translations.literal: That month Shi Le slaughtered and plundered the people of Lou and Wujin counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shi Le ravaged Lou and Wujin.

sentences.zh: 明年，石勒眾又抄略南沙、海虞。

translations.literal: The next year Shi Le’s hosts again raided Nansha and Haiyu.
translations.idiomatic: The following year his riders looted Nansha and Haiyu.

translations.literal: That eleventh month Spark-Delight guarded Stomach and the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: November stationed Mars on Stomach and the Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: Zhao and Wei will have troops.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss assigns warfare to Zhao and Wei.

sentences.zh: 」八年七月，石勒死，石季龍自立。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighth year Shi Le died and Shi Jilong seized power.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year’s eighth month ended Shi Le; Shi Hu usurped authority.

sentences.zh: 是時，雖二石僭號，而其強弱常占於昴，不關太微、紫宮也。

translations.literal: At that time although both Shi clans assumed royal titles, their rise and fall were always read from the Hairy Head, not from the Supreme Palace or Purple Forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Even as both Shis claimed thrones, fate was divined from Mao, not from the palace enclosures.

sentences.zh: 八年三月己巳，月入南斗。

translations.literal: On jisi in the third month of the eighth year the Moon entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year third month jisi repeated the lunar Dipper entry.

translations.literal: The interpretation matches the sixth year’s reading.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss matched Xianhe 6.

sentences.zh: 其年七月，石勒死，彭彪以譙，石生以長安，郭權以秦州並歸順。

translations.literal: That seventh month Shi Le died; Peng Biao held Qiao; Shi Sheng held Chang’an; Guo Quan held Qinzhou—all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: July saw Shi Le’s death while Peng Biao, Shi Sheng, and Guo Quan offered allegiance from Qiao, Chang’an, and Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 於是遣督護喬球率眾救彪，彪敗，球退。

translations.literal: The court then sent Superintendent Qiao Qiu with troops to rescue Biao; Biao was defeated and Qiu withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Superintendent Qiao Qiu marched to aid Peng Biao but retreated after defeat.

sentences.zh: 又，石季龍、石斌攻滅生、權。

translations.literal: Moreover Shi Jilong and Shi Bin attacked and destroyed Sheng and Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu and Shi Bin next crushed Sheng and Quan.

translations.literal: That seventh month Spark-Delight entered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: July brought Mars into the Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The Hu king will die.
translations.idiomatic: A barbarian king will perish.

translations.literal: Another saying: “There will be troops in Zhao territory.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao lands will see warfare.

sentences.zh: 」是月，石勒死，石季龍多所攻沒。

translations.literal: That month Shi Le died and Shi Jilong seized many districts.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shi Le passed and Shi Hu seized cities far and wide.

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Moon again transgressed the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: August repeated the lunar transit of the Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The Hu will be restless.
translations.idiomatic: Northern tribes stir.

sentences.zh: 」九年三月己亥，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。

translations.literal: On jihai in the third month of the ninth year Spark-Delight entered the Ghosts and transgressed the heaped corpses.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year third month jihai brought Mars through the Ghosts’ corpse heap.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵在西北，有沒軍死將。

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Soldiers lie northwest; armies perish and generals die.
translations.idiomatic: Northwestern hosts lose armies and commanders.

translations.literal: In the sixth and eighth months the Moon again transgressed the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: June and August repeated lunar strikes on the Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 是時，石弘雖襲勒位，而石季龍擅威橫暴，十一月廢弘自立，遂幽殺之。

translations.literal: At that time although Shi Hong inherited Shi Le’s throne, Shi Jilong wielded brutal might; in the eleventh month he deposed Hong and enthroned himself, then imprisoned and murdered him.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hong nominally succeeded but Shi Hu tyrannized; November saw Hu usurp the throne and kill Hong.

sentences.zh: 咸康元年二月己亥，太白犯昴。

translations.literal: On jihai in the second month of Xiankang 1 the Great White transgressed the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Xiankang 1 second month jihai crossed Venus over the Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms arise; drought strikes mid-year.
translations.idiomatic: Warfare and midsummer drought follow.

sentences.zh: 」四月，石季龍略騎至歷陽，加司徒王道大司馬，治兵列戍衝要。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Shi Jilong’s raiders reached Liyang; Steward Wang Dao was promoted Grand Marshal and troops deployed along every choke point.
translations.idiomatic: April brought Shi Hu’s thrust to Liyang, Wang Dao’s marshal baton, and garrisons on all passes.

translations.literal: At that time Shi Jilong again besieged Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu meanwhile tightened his siege of Xiangyang.

translations.literal: In the sixth month there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: June baked under drought.

translations.literal: That third month on bingxu the Moon entered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Third month bingxu placed the moon on the Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The Hu king will die.
translations.idiomatic: Another Hu sovereign dies.

translations.literal: On wuxu in the eighth month Spark-Delight entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month wuxu sent Mars into the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “If there were no troops, troops arise;
translations.idiomatic: Paradoxically, peace breeds war;

translations.literal: if there were troops, troops cease.
translations.idiomatic: yet active armies suddenly stall.

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Moon transgressed the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: November repeated a lunar Hairy Head crossing.

sentences.zh: 二年正月辛亥，月犯房南第二星。

translations.literal: On xinhai in the first month of the second year the Moon transgressed the second southern star of Room.
translations.idiomatic: Second year first month xinhai crossed the moon over Room’s second star.

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Moon again transgressed the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: August repeated the lunar Hairy Head transit.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，太白犯南斗，因晝見。

translations.literal: On gengyin in the ninth month the Great White transgressed the Southern Dipper and thereby appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: September gengyin made Venus cross the Dipper and blaze in daylight.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「斗為宰相，又揚州分，金犯之，死喪之象。

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The Dipper is the ministerial seat; it also marks Yangzhou’s field; when metal transgresses it, the image is death and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper stands for chancellors and Yangzhou; Venus there spells bereavement.

translations.literal: Appearance by daylight means disloyal subjects and likewise armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Daylight Venus adds rebellion and martial grief.

sentences.zh: 」其後，石季龍僭稱天王，發眾七萬；

translations.literal: Afterward Shi Jilong arrogated the title Heavenly King and mobilized seventy thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Hu then styled himself Heavenly King and levied seventy thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 四年二月自隴西攻殺段遼於薊，又襲慕容皝於棘城，不克，皝擊破其將麻秋，並虜段遼殺之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year’s second month he marched from Longxi, attacked and killed Duan Liao at Ji, then struck Murong Huang at Jicheng without success; Huang routed his general Ma Qiu and captured Duan Liao, executing him.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year second month Hu marched from Longxi, slew Duan Liao at Ji, failed against Murong Huang at Jicheng, lost Ma Qiu, and watched Huang execute Duan Liao.

sentences.zh: 三年七月己酉，月犯房上星。

translations.literal: On jiyou in the seventh month of the third year the Moon transgressed the upper star of Room.
translations.idiomatic: Third year seventh month jiyou crossed the moon over Room’s upper star.

sentences.zh: 八月，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Spark-Delight entered the Ghosts and transgressed the heaped corpses.
translations.idiomatic: August brought Mars through the Ghosts’ corpse stars.

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Moon transgressed the separator stars of the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxu saw a lunar Eastern Well transit.

translations.literal: On wuzi in the ninth month the Moon transgressed the Establishment Stars.
translations.idiomatic: September wuzi crossed the Establishment asterism.

sentences.zh: 四年四月己巳，太白晝見，在柳。

translations.literal: On jisi in the fourth month of the fourth year the Great White was seen by day in the Willow.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year fourth month jisi showed Venus by daylight in the Willow.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops and disloyal subjects.
translations.idiomatic: The reading predicts warfare and treason.

sentences.zh: 」明年，石季龍大寇沔南，於是內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: The next year Shi Jilong raided the Han River south in force; court and camp alike went on full alert.
translations.idiomatic: Next year Shi Hu stormed south of the Han, triggering universal mobilization.

sentences.zh: 其五月戊戌，熒惑犯右執法。

translations.literal: That fifth month on wuxu Spark-Delight transgressed the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month wuxu placed Mars on the Right Enforcer.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers die; those in power grieve.
translations.idiomatic: High ministers perish and those holding sway mourn.

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Great White again transgressed the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: September brought another Venus transit of the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 案占：「五星災同，金火尤甚。

translations.literal: Investigating the prognostication: “Calamities of the Five Planets follow the same pattern; metal and fire are especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Standard glosses treat the five planets alike in disaster, worst when Venus or Mars appear.

translations.literal: On wuzi in the eleventh month the Great White transgressed the upper star of Room.
translations.idiomatic: November wuzi placed Venus on Room’s upper star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The upper minister will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: The senior minister faces peril.

translations.literal: On yiwei in the fourth month of the fifth year the Moon transgressed the separator star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year fourth month yiwei crossed the moon over the Net’s separator.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms will arise.
translations.idiomatic: Warfare follows.

translations.literal: On jiyou in the seventh month the Moon transgressed the upper star of Room.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month jiyou repeated the lunar strike on Room’s upper star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals and ministers will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders and ministers grieve.

sentences.zh: 」是月庚申，丞相王導薨，庾冰代輔政。

translations.literal: That month on gengshen Chancellor Wang Dao died; Yu Bing succeeded him in assisting government.
translations.idiomatic: Gengshen that month ended Wang Dao; Yu Bing took regency.

translations.literal: In the eighth month Grand Commandant Xi Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Xi Jian died in the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 又有沔南邾城之敗，百姓流亡萬餘家。

translations.literal: Moreover there was defeat at Zhucheng on the Han south; more than ten thousand households fled.
translations.idiomatic: Defeat at Zhu city south of the Han sent over ten thousand families fleeing.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，征西大將軍庾亮薨。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year General Who Conquers the West Yu Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year’s first month saw Yu Liang’s death.

sentences.zh: 六年三月甲辰，熒惑犯太微外將星。

translations.literal: On jiachen in the third month Spark-Delight transgressed the outer general star of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Third month jiachen brought Mars across the Supreme Palace’s outer general.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The upper general will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: The senior general is imperiled.

translations.literal: On dingchou in the fourth month Spark-Delight transgressed the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month dingchou placed Mars on the Right Enforcer.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Those who wield government will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Those in power face alarm.

translations.literal: On yihai in the sixth month the Moon transgressed the central star of the Herdsman.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month yihai crossed the moon over the Herdsman’s middle star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Great generals will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Top commanders are endangered.

sentences.zh: 」是時，尚書今何充為執法，有譴，欲避其咎，明年求為中書令。

translations.literal: At that time Minister Secretary He Chong held the Enforcer office and faced censure; wishing to escape blame, the next year he requested appointment as Palace Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Secretary He Chong, holding the Enforcer portfolio and under criticism, sought transfer to Palace Secretary the next year to dodge fault.

sentences.zh: 其四月丙午，太白犯畢距星。

translations.literal: That fourth month on bingwu the Great White transgressed the separator star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month bingwu saw Venus cross the Net’s separator.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Armor and weapons arise.
translations.idiomatic: Military upheaval erupts.

translations.literal: Another saying: “The principal consort will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: The empress faces peril.

translations.literal: On yimao in the sixth month the Great White transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month yimao placed Venus on Regulus.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: The chief lady of the palace is imperiled.

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventh year Empress Du died.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Du died in the seventh year’s third month.

translations.literal: On renwu in the third month of the seventh year the Moon transgressed Room.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year third month renwu brought the moon across Room.

translations.literal: On jichou in the fourth month the Great White entered the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month jichou sent Venus into the Ghosts.

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: May showed Venus by daylight.

translations.literal: On xinchou in the eighth month the Moon transgressed the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month xinchou repeated a lunar Ghosts transit.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，熒惑犯房上第二星。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year Spark-Delight transgressed the second upper star of Room.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year sixth month Mars crossed Room’s second upper star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The secondary minister will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: The junior minister is endangered.

translations.literal: On renyin in the eighth month the Moon transgressed the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month renyin brought the moon across the Net.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Inferiors offend superiors; armor and weapons arise.
translations.idiomatic: Subjects rebel against rulers and war follows.

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Moon again covered the great star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: October the moon occulted the Net’s chief star.

translations.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss matched earlier entries.

sentences.zh: 其建元二年，車騎將軍庾冰薨。

translations.literal: In Jianyuan 2 General of Chariots and Cavalry Yu Bing died.
translations.idiomatic: Jianyuan 2 saw Yu Bing’s death.

sentences.zh: 庾翼大發兵，謀伐石季龍，專制上流，朝廷憚之。

translations.literal: Yu Yi mobilized great armies planning to campaign against Shi Jilong, monopolizing the upper Yangzi while the court feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yi massed troops against Shi Hu, controlling the middle Yangzi and intimidating Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 康帝建元元年正月壬午，太白入昴。

translations.literal: On renwu in the first month of Emperor Kang’s Jianyuan 1 the Great White entered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Kang’s Jianyuan 1 New Year renwu placed Venus in the Hairy Head.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops in Zhao territory.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao lands face warfare.

translations.literal: It also says: “Under Heaven troops arise everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Another line predicts empire-wide arms.

translations.literal: On yiyou in the fourth month the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month yiyou showed Venus by daylight.

sentences.zh: 是年，石季龍殺其子邃，又遣將寇沒狄道，及屯薊東，謀慕容皝。

translations.literal: That year Shi Jilong killed his son Sui, sent generals to raid Didao, camped east of Ji, and plotted against Murong Huang.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shi Hu murdered Shi Sui, raided Didao, stacked troops east of Ji, and eyed Murong Huang.

translations.literal: In the second year the Year Star transgressed Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Year two Jupiter crossed Celestial Pass.

sentences.zh: 安西將軍庾翼與兄冰書曰：「歲星犯天關，占云關梁當分。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the West Yu Yi wrote his elder brother Bing: “The Year Star transgressed Celestial Pass; divination says passes and bridges should split.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Yi wrote Yu Bing that Jupiter at Celestial Pass meant frontier crossings would break.

sentences.zh: 比來江東無他故，江道亦不艱難，而石季龍頻年再閉關，不通信使，此復是天公憒憒，無皁白之徵也。

translations.literal: Lately east of the river there has been no other crisis, nor is the Yangzi passage especially hard; yet Shi Jilong has repeatedly sealed the passes these years and blocked envoys—again Heaven’s confusion without clear black-or-white signs.
translations.idiomatic: East of the Yangzi all seemed calm and the river open, yet Shi Hu repeatedly shut the passes and cut messengers—Heaven still muddled the portents.

translations.literal: That intercalary month on yiyou the Great White transgressed the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary yiyou saw Venus cross the Dipper.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be mourning; under Heaven receives ranks and stipends.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning spreads while the realm grants titles and salaries.

translations.literal: In the ninth month the emperor died; the heir apparent succeeded, a great amnesty was proclaimed, and noble ranks were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: September brought the emperor’s death, the heir’s accession, amnesty, and ennoblements.

sentences.zh: 穆帝永和元年正月丁丑，月入畢。

translations.literal: On dingchou in the first month of Emperor Mu’s Yonghe 1 the Moon entered the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Mu’s Yonghe 1 dingchou placed the moon in the Net.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Great armies arise.
translations.idiomatic: Major warfare erupts.

translations.literal: On wuyin the Moon transgressed Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyin saw a lunar transit of Celestial Pass.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有亂臣更天子之法。

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be rebellious ministers who alter the Son of Heaven’s institutions.
translations.idiomatic: Treacherous ministers will tamper with imperial law.

translations.literal: On xinsi in the fifth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month xinsi showed Venus by daylight within the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Ministers grow powerful; Qin will have troops.
translations.idiomatic: Subjects wax strong while Qin faces arms.

sentences.zh: 」六月辛丑，月入太微，犯屏西南星。

translations.literal: On xinchou in the sixth month the Moon entered the Supreme Palace and transgressed the southwest star of the screen.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month xinchou brought the moon into the Supreme Palace across the screen’s southwest star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Among assisting ministers some will be dismissed or removed.
translations.idiomatic: Senior counselors suffer demotion or dismissal.

translations.literal: In the seventh and eighth months the Moon both transgressed the Net.
translations.idiomatic: July and August each saw lunar Net transits.

translations.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.
translations.idiomatic: The gloss matched earlier readings.

translations.literal: On jiwei the Moon transgressed the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Jiwei crossing of the Ghosts by the moon.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: High ministers face execution.

translations.literal: Yin Hao’s northern expedition failed; he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Hao’s northern march collapsed and cost him office.

sentences.zh: 六年二月辛酉，月犯心大星。

translations.idiomatic: Generals and ministers bear the omen.

translations.idiomatic: June yihai crossed the Winnowing Basket.

translations.idiomatic: Bingzi crossed the Dipper.

translations.idiomatic: Year seven Liu Xian slew Shi Zhi and generals, Shanxi erupted in turmoil and plague.

sentences.zh: 八年三月戊戌，月犯軒轅大星。

sentences.zh: 二年八月，豫州刺史謝奕薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year Inspector of Yuzhou Xie Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: Second year eighth month Xie Yi died in office.

sentences.zh: 二年二月辛卯，填星犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On xinmao in the second month of the second year the Station Star transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: Second year second month xinmao Saturn crossed Regulus.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The ruler will find it ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign should dread the sign.

translations.literal: On jiawu the Moon transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu crossed the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: On xinyou in the sixth month the Moon transgressed Room.
translations.idiomatic: June xinyou crossed Room.

translations.literal: On jiwei in the tenth month the Great White transgressed the Weeping Stars.
translations.idiomatic: October jiwei Venus crossed the Weeping asterism.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be great weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Great lamentation follows.

sentences.zh: 」三年正月壬辰，熒惑犯楗閉星。

translations.literal: On renchen in the first month of the third year Spark-Delight transgressed Key-and-Bolt.
translations.idiomatic: Third year New Year renchen Mars crossed Key-and-Bolt.

translations.literal: Investigating the archive gloss: “The ruler will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: Library readings warn the sovereign.

translations.literal: On yiyou in the third month Spark-Delight retrograded and transgressed Hook-and-Hasp.
translations.idiomatic: March yiyou retrograde Mars struck Hook-and-Hasp.

translations.literal: Investigating the gloss: “The king finds it ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: Archives dread the sign for rulers.

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: June Venus crossed the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: On yiyou in the seventh month Spark-Delight transgressed Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: July yiyou Mars crossed Celestial River.

translations.literal: On bingxu the Great White transgressed the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Bingxu Venus entered the Ghosts.

translations.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.
translations.idiomatic: Every gloss matched earlier entries.

sentences.zh: 戊子，月犯牽牛中央大星。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Moon transgressed the central great star of the Herdsman.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzi crossed the Herdsman’s central star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The Herdsman is Heaven’s general.
translations.idiomatic: The Herdsman marks Heaven’s commander.

translations.literal: Transgressing its central great star means generals will die.
translations.idiomatic: Striking its middle luminary kills generals.

translations.literal: On dingwei in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: August dingwei Venus crossed Regulus.

translations.literal: On jiazi the Moon transgressed the great star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Jiazi crossed the Net’s chief star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: Border warfare erupts.

translations.literal: Another saying: “Inferiors offend superiors.
translations.idiomatic: Subjects rebel against lords.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，諸葛恢舟軍入河，敗績。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the third year Zhuge Hui’s river fleet entered the Yellow River and was crushed.
translations.idiomatic: October Zhuge Hui’s boats sailed up the river and met disaster.

sentences.zh: 豫州刺史謝萬入潁，眾潰而歸，萬除名。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yuzhou Xie Wan marched into Ying; his host routed and he returned stripped of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Wan’s Ying expedition collapsed and cost him his title.

sentences.zh: 十一月，司徒會稽王以郗曇、謝萬二鎮敗，求自敗，求自貶三等。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Minister of Education, Prince of Kuaiji, citing defeats on the Xi Tan and Xie Wan fronts, offered repeatedly to demote himself three grades.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Kuaiji asked thrice to lower his rank three steps after Xi Tan and Xie Wan’s losses.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，慕容雋死，子暐代立。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year Murong Jun died; his son Wei succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year’s New Year buried Murong Jun; Murong Wei succeeded.

sentences.zh: 慕容恪殺其尚書令陽騖等。

translations.literal: Murong Ke executed Minister Secretary Yang Wu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Ke killed Yang Wu and colleagues.

sentences.zh: 四年正月乙亥，月犯牽牛中央大星。

translations.literal: On yihai in the first month of the fourth year the Moon transgressed the central great star of the Herdsman.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month yihai crossed the Herdsman’s central star.

translations.literal: On xinhai in the sixth month the Dawn Star transgressed the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: June xinhai Mercury crossed Regulus.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: The empress faces peril.

sentences.zh: 」己未，太白入太微右掖門，從端門出。

translations.literal: On jiwei the Great White entered the right-side gate of the Purple Forbidden Palace and exited through the Portal Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Jiwei Venus slipped through the Supreme Palace’s right gate out the Vermilion Portal.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Nobles will lose power.
translations.idiomatic: Magnates forfeit influence.

translations.literal: Another saying: “There will be troops.
translations.idiomatic: Arms arise.

translations.literal: It also says: “Emerging from the Portal Gate means ministers are no longer ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Leaving the Portal Gate marks ministers betraying duty.

translations.literal: On wushen in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the Base.
translations.idiomatic: August wushen Venus crossed the Base.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: The realm mourns.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，熒惑犯太微西蕃上將星。

translations.literal: On bingchen Spark-Delight transgressed the Upper General on the Supreme Palace’s western bastion.
translations.idiomatic: Bingchen Mars struck the western Upper General.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，太白入南斗口，犯第四星。

translations.literal: On renwu in the ninth month the Great White entered the mouth of the Southern Dipper and transgressed the fourth star.
translations.idiomatic: September renwu Venus entered the Dipper mouth on its fourth star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為喪，有赦，天下受爵祿。

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be mourning, amnesty, and under Heaven receiving ranks and stipends.
translations.idiomatic: Expect bereavement, pardon, and empire-wide ennoblements.

translations.literal: On jiayin in the twelfth month Spark-Delight transgressed Room.
translations.idiomatic: December jiayin brought Mars across Room.

translations.literal: On bingyin the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Bingyin Venus shone by day.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，月犯健閉，占曰：「人君惡之。

translations.literal: On gengyin the Moon transgressed Key-and-Bolt; the interpretation says: “The ruler finds it ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: Gengyin’s lunar Key-and-Bolt crossing warned the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 」五年正月乙巳，填星逆行，犯太微。

translations.literal: On yisi in the first month of the fifth year the Station Star moved retrograde and transgressed the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year New Year yisi Saturn retrograded into the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: On renyin in the fifth month the Moon transgressed the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: May renyin crossed the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: On gengxu the Moon transgressed the Establishment Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Gengxu crossed the Establishment asterism.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers plot against one another.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers intrigue.

translations.literal: At that time Yin Hao’s armies were ruined and he ended in exile.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Hao’s defeat brought banishment.

translations.literal: That month on xinhai the Moon transgressed the Ox lodge.
translations.idiomatic: Month’s xinhai crossed the Ox.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: The dynasty grieves.

translations.literal: On guihai in the sixth month the Moon transgressed the northeastern star of the Base.
translations.idiomatic: June guihai crossed the Base’s northeast star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The grand marshal will answer for it.
translations.idiomatic: The marshal bears the omen.

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year General of the Northern Army Xi Tan died.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year’s first month buried Xi Tan.

sentences.zh: 五月，帝崩，哀帝立，大赦，賜爵，褚後失勢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the emperor died; Emperor Ai succeeded with great amnesty, titles granted, and Empress Chu losing influence.
translations.idiomatic: May’s imperial death enthroned Emperor Ai with amnesty while Empress Chu fell from power.

sentences.zh: 七月，慕容恪攻冀州刺史呂護于野王，護奔滎陽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Murong Ke besieged Inspector of Jizhou Lu Hu at Yewang; Lu fled to Xingyang.
translations.idiomatic: July Murong Ke trapped Lu Hu at Yewang until Lu bolted to Xingyang.

sentences.zh: 是時，桓溫以大眾次宛，聞護敗，乃退。

translations.literal: At that time Huan Wen massed at Wan; hearing of Lu’s defeat he withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Wen camped at Wan but retired on Lu’s rout.

sentences.zh: 五年六月癸酉，月奄氐東北星。

translations.literal: On guiyou in the sixth month of the fifth year the Moon occulted the northeastern star of the Base.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year sixth month guiyou occulted the Base’s northeast star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The Grand Marshal will answer for it.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Marshal bears it.

translations.literal: On yiyou in the ninth month the Moon occulted the Net.
translations.idiomatic: September yiyou occulted the Net.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: Border arms arise.

translations.literal: On dingwei in the tenth month the Moon transgressed the great star of the Net.
translations.idiomatic: October dingwei crossed the Net’s chief star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Inferiors offend superiors.
translations.idiomatic: Subjects rebel.

translations.literal: It also says: “There will be frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: Border warfare again.

translations.literal: In the eighth month Fan Wang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Wang lost office in August.

sentences.zh: 隆和元年，慕容暐遣將寇河陰。

translations.literal: In Longhe 1 Murong Wei sent generals to raid Heyin.
translations.idiomatic: Longhe 1 Murong Wei struck Heyin.

sentences.zh: 哀帝興寧三年七月庚戌，月犯南斗。

translations.literal: On gengxu in the seventh month of Emperor Ai’s Xingning 3 the Moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ai’s Xingning 3 seventh month gengxu crossed the Dipper.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: The empress faces peril.

translations.literal: The Year Star transgressed the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter crossed the Ghosts.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The ruler will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign grieves.

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Neck.
translations.idiomatic: October daylight Venus shone in the Neck.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「亢為朝廷，有兵喪，為臣強。

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The Neck is the court; there will be armies and mourning; ministers grow powerful.
translations.idiomatic: The Neck marks court business—arms, mourning, and domineering ministers.

translations.literal: The next fifth month Empress Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: The following May Empress Yu passed away.

sentences.zh: 海西太和二年正月，太白入昴。

translations.literal: In the first month of Emperor Hai’s Taihe 2 the Great White entered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Hai’s Taihe 2 New Year Venus entered Mao.

sentences.zh: 五年，慕容暐為苻堅所滅，又據司、冀、幽、并四州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Murong Wei fell to Fu Jian who then held Si, Ji, You, and Bing.
translations.idiomatic: Year five Fu Jian destroyed Murong Wei and seized four northern provinces.

sentences.zh: 六年閏月，熒惑守太微端門。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of the sixth year Spark-Delight guarded the Portal Gate of the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year’s leap month stationed Mars on the Portal Gate.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven loses his state.
translations.idiomatic: The dynasty falls.

translations.literal: It also says: “Marquises and Three Dukes plot against their ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Nobles conspire against the throne.

translations.literal: Another saying: “There will be executed ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers face execution.

translations.literal: On xinmao the Moon transgressed the great star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Xinmao crossed Antares.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The king finds it ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: Rulers dread it.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，桓溫廢帝，並奏誅武陵王，簡文不許，溫乃徙之新安，皆臣強之應也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Huan Wen deposed the emperor and memorialized to execute Prince Wuling; Emperor Jianwen forbade it, so Wen banished him to Xin’an—all responses to overpowerful ministers.
translations.idiomatic: November Huan Wen’s deposition and attempted purge of Prince Wuling illustrated ministerial dominance.

sentences.zh: 簡文咸安元年十二月辛卯，熒惑逆行入太微，二年三月猶不退。

translations.literal: On xinmao in the twelfth month of Emperor Jianwen’s Xian’an 1 Spark-Delight retrograded into the Supreme Palace and still had not withdrawn by the third month of year 2.
translations.idiomatic: Xian’an 1 December xinmao began Mars’ retrograde Supreme Palace stay lasting into year two.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The state is not secure; there is sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: The realm lacks stability.

translations.literal: At that time the emperor suffered Huan Wen’s coercion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor lived under Huan Wen’s thumb.

sentences.zh: 二年五月丁未，太白犯天關。

translations.literal: On dingwei in the second year’s fifth month the Great White transgressed Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Year two fifth month dingwei Venus crossed Celestial Pass.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms will arise.
translations.idiomatic: Warfare erupts.

translations.literal: The Year Star’s color and shape resembled the Great White.
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter looked like Venus in hue.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Advancing and retreating according to measure means treachery subsides;
translations.idiomatic: Regular motion stills villainy;

translations.literal: Changed colors and chaotic motion mean the ruler lacks blessing.
translations.idiomatic: erratic color and course deny the sovereign fortune.

sentences.zh: 歲星于仲夏當細小而不明，此其失常也。

translations.literal: The Year Star at midsummer ought to be faint and small; here it failed that norm.
translations.idiomatic: Midsummer Jupiter should be dim—its brilliance broke the rule.

translations.literal: It also means ministers grow powerful.
translations.idiomatic: It likewise signals overpowerful ministers.

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: June daylight Venus shone in the Seven Stars.

translations.literal: On yiyou the Great White transgressed the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: Yiyou Venus crossed the Ghosts.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: The realm mourns.

sentences.zh: 」七月，帝崩，桓溫以兵威擅權，將誅王坦之等，內外迫脅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the emperor died; Huan Wen wielded military awe and usurpatory power, prepared to execute Wang Tanzhi and others, coercing court and camp alike.
translations.idiomatic: July’s imperial death let Huan Wen terrorize the realm and threaten Wang Tanzhi.

sentences.zh: 又，庾希入京城，盧悚入宮，並誅滅之。

translations.literal: Moreover Yu Xi entered the capital district and Lu Song entered the palace; both were exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xi and Lu Song’s palace intrigues ended in slaughter.

sentences.zh: 孝武甯康元年正月戊申，月奄心大星。

translations.literal: On wushen in the first month of Emperor Xiaowu’s Ningkang 1 the Moon occulted the great star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu’s Ningkang 1 New Year wushen occulted Antares.

sentences.zh: 案上曰：「災不在王者，則在豫州。

translations.literal: Investigating the superior gloss: “If calamity spares the king, it falls on Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Archives say if not the sovereign, Yu Province suffers.

translations.literal: Another saying: “The ruler’s mandate finds it ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign’s fate turns grim.

translations.literal: On bingwu in the third month the Moon occulted the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: March bingwu occulted the Dipper’s fifth star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers grieve; there is death.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers mourn and men die.

translations.literal: Another saying: “Generals will die.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders perish.

translations.literal: In the seventh month Huan Wen died.
translations.idiomatic: July buried Huan Wen.

translations.literal: On guisi in the ninth month Spark-Delight entered the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: September guisi Mars entered the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 是時，女主臨朝，政事多缺。

translations.literal: At that time the chief lady held court; governance suffered many lapses.
translations.idiomatic: The regent empress ruled imperfectly.

sentences.zh: 二年閏月己未，月奄牽牛南星。

translations.literal: On jiwei in the intercalary month of the second year the Moon occulted the southern star of the Herdsman.
translations.idiomatic: Year two leap month jiwei occulted the Herdsman’s south star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The general of the left will die.
translations.idiomatic: The left commander dies.

translations.literal: On jiashen in the twelfth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Base.
translations.idiomatic: December jiashen daylight Venus shone in the Base.

translations.literal: The Base is Yanzhou’s celestial field.
translations.idiomatic: The Base governs Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年五月丙午，北中郎將王坦之薨。

translations.literal: On bingwu in the fifth month of the third year General of the Northern Army Wang Tanzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: Third year fifth month Wang Tanzhi died.

sentences.zh: 三年六月辛卯，太白犯東井。

translations.literal: On xinmao in the sixth month of the third year the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Third year sixth month xinmao Venus crossed the Eastern Well.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin territory will have troops.
translations.idiomatic: Qin lands face warfare.

translations.literal: On wushen in the ninth month Spark-Delight occulted the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: September wushen Mars occulted the Left Enforcer.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Those holding enforcement offices die.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who wield law perish.

translations.literal: In Taixuan 1 Fu Jian conquered Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Taixuan 1 Fu Jian took Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年十月，尚書令王彪之卒。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the second year Minister Secretary Wang Biaozhi died.
translations.idiomatic: Second year October Wang Biaozhi died.

sentences.zh: 太元元年四月丙戌，熒惑犯南斗第三星。

translations.literal: On bingxu in the fourth month of Taixuan 1 Spark-Delight transgressed the third star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Taixuan 1 fourth month bingxu Mars crossed the Dipper’s third star.

translations.literal: On bingshen it again occulted the fourth star.
translations.idiomatic: Bingshen occulted the fourth star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Great armies arise and the Middle Kingdom starves.
translations.idiomatic: Mass warfare brings famine to the heartland.

translations.literal: Another saying: “There will be amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A general pardon follows.

translations.literal: On guiyou in the eighth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Base.
translations.idiomatic: August guiyou daylight Venus shone in the Base.

translations.literal: The Base is Yanzhou’s celestial field.
translations.idiomatic: That lodge marks Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，熒惑犯哭泣星，遂入羽林。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Spark-Delight transgressed the Weeping Stars and then entered the Forbidden Guards.
translations.idiomatic: September Mars crossed the Weepers and entered the imperial guards.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子有哭泣事，中軍兵起。

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven has occasions for weeping; the central army rises.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor weeps while palace troops mobilize.

translations.literal: On jiwei in the eleventh month the Moon occulted the horn of the Base.
translations.idiomatic: November jiwei occulted the Base’s horn.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Under Heaven there will be troops.
translations.idiomatic: Empire-wide arms.

translations.literal: Another saying: “The state will have sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: National mourning.

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year Spark-Delight guarded the Forbidden Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Year two February Mars stationed in the palace guard stars.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Palace troops rise on a grand scale.
translations.idiomatic: Inner armies surge.

translations.literal: On renwu in the ninth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Horn.
translations.idiomatic: September renwu daylight Venus shone in the Horn.

translations.literal: The Horn is Yanzhou’s celestial field.
translations.idiomatic: The Horn maps Yanzhou.

translations.literal: In the fifth month of Shengping 1 there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Shengping 1 May proclaimed sweeping pardon.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，秦人寇樊、鄧、襄陽、彭城。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year Qin raiders struck Fan, Deng, Xiangyang, and Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: Third year eighth month Former Qin hit strategic towns.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，襄陽陷，朱序沒。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year Xiangyang fell and Zhu Xu was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year February Xiangyang collapsed with Zhu Xu taken.

sentences.zh: 四月，魏興陷，賊聚廣陵、三河，眾五六萬。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Weixing fell; bandits massed at Guangling and Sanhe—fifty or sixty thousand strong.
translations.idiomatic: April Weixing fell while rebels gathered fifty thousand plus.

sentences.zh: 於是諸軍外次沖要，丹陽尹屯衛京都。

translations.literal: Then each army camped on exterior choke points while the metropolitan prefect garrisoned the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Hosts guarded passes as the capital prefect defended Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 六月，兗州刺史謝玄討賊，大破之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Inspector of Yanzhou Xie Xuan attacked the bandits and shattered them.
translations.idiomatic: June Xie Xuan routed the rebels.

sentences.zh: 是時，中外連兵，比年荒儉。

translations.literal: At that time interior and exterior alike were at arms and famine stalked successive years.
translations.idiomatic: Empire-wide war met year-on-year dearth.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月丁巳，太白犯哭星。

translations.literal: On dingsi in the fourth year’s eleventh month the Great White transgressed the Weeping Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year November dingsi Venus crossed the Weepers.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven will have occasions for weeping.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor faces lamentation.

translations.literal: On bingzi in the fifth month of the seventh year the Dawn Star transgressed the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year fifth month bingzi Mercury crossed Regulus.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will answer for it.
translations.idiomatic: The empress bears the sign.

translations.literal: On guiwei in the ninth month Empress Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: September guiwei buried Empress Wang.

translations.literal: On bingzi in the ninth month of the sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year ninth month bingzi.

translations.literal: The Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Venus appeared by daylight.

sentences.zh: 七年十一月，太白又晝見，在斗。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventh year the Great White was again seen in daytime in the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh year November daylight Venus returned in the Dipper.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Wu will suffer armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Wu faces war and grief.

sentences.zh: 」八年四月甲子，太白又晝見，在參。

translations.literal: On jiazi in the eighth year’s fourth month the Great White was again seen in daytime in the Triaster.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth year fourth month jiazi daylight Venus shone in Orion’s belt.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Wei will suffer armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Wei meets campaigns and mourning.

sentences.zh: 」是月，桓沖征沔漢，楊亮伐蜀，並拔城略地。

translations.literal: That month Huan Chong campaigned along the Han while Yang Liang attacked Shu; both took cities and territory.
translations.idiomatic: That month Huan Chong and Yang Liang advanced on multiple fronts.

sentences.zh: 八月，苻堅自將，號百萬，九月，攻沒壽陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Fu Jian led hosts touted at a million; in the ninth month he captured Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: August Fu Jian marched; September Shouchun fell.

sentences.zh: 十月，劉牢之破苻堅將梁成，斬之，殺獲萬餘人。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Liu Laozhi defeated Fu Jian’s general Liang Cheng, beheaded him, and killed or captured over ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: October Liu Laozhi slew Liang Cheng and claimed myriad captives.

sentences.zh: 謝玄等又破苻堅于淝水，斬其弟融，堅大眾奔潰。

translations.literal: Xie Xuan and others defeated Fu Jian at the Fei River, cut down his brother Rong, and his grand army fled in panic.
translations.idiomatic: Feishui saw Fu Jian shattered—Rong died and the horde routed.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，皇太后褚氏崩。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the ninth year Empress Dowager Chu died.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth year ninth month buried Empress Dowager Chu.

sentences.zh: 八月，謝玄出屯彭城，經略中州矣。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Xie Xuan advanced to camp at Pengcheng, planning the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: August Xie Xuan encamped at Pengcheng to reclaim the north.

sentences.zh: 九年七月丙戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On bingxu in the ninth month’s seventh day the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month bingxu daylight Venus.

translations.literal: On dingsi in the eleventh month it again appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: November dingsi repeated daylight Venus.

sentences.zh: 十年四月乙亥，又晝見於畢昴。

translations.literal: On yihai in the tenth year’s fourth month it again appeared by day in Mao and the Net.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth year April yihai daylight Venus in Mao.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Wei will have armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Wei faces martial bereavement.

sentences.zh: 」是時苻堅大眾奔潰，趙魏連兵相攻，堅為姚萇所殺。

translations.literal: At that time Fu Jian’s masses fled in defeat; Zhao and Wei exchanged blows; Fu Jian died at Yao Chang’s hands.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Jian’s collapse unleashed northern warfare until Yao Chang killed him.

sentences.zh: 十一年三月戊申，太白晝見，在東井。

translations.literal: On wushen in the eleventh year’s third month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh year March wushen daylight Venus in the Well.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have troops; ministers grow powerful.
translations.idiomatic: Qin suffers arms and strong ministers.

translations.literal: On jiashen in the sixth month it again appeared by day in the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: June jiashen daylight Venus in the Ghosts.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have troops.
translations.idiomatic: Qin faces warfare.

sentences.zh: 」時魏、姚萇、苻登連兵，相征不息。

translations.literal: At that time Wei, Yao Chang, and Fu Deng continually campaigned against one another.
translations.idiomatic: Wei, Yao Chang, and Fu Deng traded blows without respite.

translations.literal: On jiawu the Year Star was seen in daytime in the Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: Jiawu daylight Jupiter in the Stomach.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Lu will have troops; ministers grow powerful.
translations.idiomatic: Lu suffers arms and domineering ministers.

sentences.zh: 」十二年，慕容垂寇東阿，翟遼寇河上，姚萇假號安定，苻登自立隴上，呂光竊據涼土。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Murong Chui raided Dong’e, Zhai Liao struck the Yellow River, Yao Chang styled himself at Anding, Fu Deng rose on Longshang, and Lü Guang seized Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth year saw Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, and Lü Guang carve independent realms.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月癸卯，太白晝見，在柳。

translations.literal: On guimao in the twelfth year’s sixth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Willow.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth year June guimao daylight Venus in the Willow.

sentences.zh: 十月庚午，太白晝見，在斗。

translations.literal: On gengwu in the tenth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: October gengwu daylight Venus in the Dipper.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月丙戌，又晝見。

translations.literal: On bingxu in the thirteenth year’s first month it again appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth year New Year bingxu daylight Venus.

sentences.zh: 十二月，熒惑在角亢，形色猛盛。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Spark-Delight stood in Horn and Neck with fierce color and brilliance.
translations.idiomatic: December Mars glared in Horn and Neck.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「熒惑失其常，吏且棄其法，諸侯亂其政。

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “When Spark-Delight loses its norm, clerks abandon law and feudatories disorder government.
translations.idiomatic: Erratic Mars means officials discard statutes and lords rebel.

sentences.zh: 」自是後，慕容垂、翟遼、姚萇、苻登、慕容永並阻兵爭強。

translations.literal: Afterward Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, Murong Yong barricaded troops and vied for supremacy.
translations.idiomatic: Those warlords then contested without pause.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月，彭城妖賊又稱號於皇丘，劉牢之破滅之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year Pengcheng spirit-bandits styled themselves at Huangqiu until Liu Laozhi destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year New Year bandits at Huangqiu fell to Liu Laozhi.

sentences.zh: 三月，張道破合鄉，圍泰山，向欽之擊走之。

translations.literal: In the third month Zhang Dao broke Hexiang, besieged Taishan, and Xiang Qinzhi drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: March Zhang Dao raided until Xiang Qinzhi repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 是年，翟遼又攻沒滎陽，侵略陳項。

translations.literal: That year Zhai Liao again seized Xingyang and raided Chen and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Liao repeated strikes on the Central Plain.

sentences.zh: 于時政事多弊，君道陵遲矣。

translations.literal: At that time governance suffered many abuses and sovereign conduct declined.
translations.idiomatic: Government rotted and royal virtue sank.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月乙巳，太白晝見於柳。

translations.literal: On yisi in the fourteenth year’s fourth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Willow.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth year April yisi daylight Willow Venus.

translations.literal: On xinmao in the sixth month it again appeared by day in the Wings.
translations.idiomatic: June xinmao daylight Venus in Wings.

translations.literal: On bingyin in the ninth month it again appeared by day in the Wings.
translations.idiomatic: September bingyin daylight Venus in Wings.

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Spark-Delight entered the Forbidden Guards.
translations.idiomatic: December Mars entered the palace guard stars.

translations.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.
translations.idiomatic: Every gloss matched earlier readings.

sentences.zh: 十五年，翟遼掠司兗，眾軍累討不克，慕容垂又跨略并、冀等州。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Zhai Liao pillaged Si and Yanzhou; hosts repeatedly campaigned without victory while Murong Chui seized Bing and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Year fifteen Zhai Liao ravaged the east even as Murong Chui swallowed Bing-Ji.

translations.literal: In the seventh month drought struck.
translations.idiomatic: July baked under drought.

sentences.zh: 八月，諸郡大水，兗州又蝗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month commanderies flooded while Yanzhou suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: August floods and Yanzhou locusts compounded misery.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月癸未，熒惑入太微。

translations.literal: On guiwei in the ninth month of the fifteenth year Spark-Delight entered the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth year September guiwei Mars entered the Supreme Palace.

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Great White entered the Forbidden Guards.
translations.idiomatic: October Venus entered the Forbidden Guards.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月癸卯朔，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On guimao new moon in the sixteenth year’s fourth month the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteenth year fourth month new moon guimao daylight Venus.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，月奄心前星。

translations.literal: On guisi in the eleventh month the Moon occulted the forward star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: November guisi occulted the Heart’s leading star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The heir apparent will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince faces peril.

translations.literal: At that time the heir apparent continually suffered grave illness.
translations.idiomatic: The heir lay chronically ill.

sentences.zh: 十七年七月丁丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On dingchou in the seventh month of the seventeenth year the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeenth year July dingchou daylight Venus.

translations.literal: On dingyou in the tenth month it again appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: October dingyou repeated daylight Venus.

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year it again appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteenth year June daylight Venus returned.

sentences.zh: 十九年五月，又晝見於柳。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year it again appeared by day in the Willow.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteenth year May daylight Venus in the Willow.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，又晝見於輿鬼。

translations.literal: On xinyou in the sixth month it again appeared by day in the Ghosts.
translations.idiomatic: June xinyou daylight Venus in the Ghosts.

translations.literal: In the ninth month it again appeared in the Wings.
translations.idiomatic: September repeated Venus in Wings.

sentences.zh: 二十年六年，熒惑入天囷。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year’s sixth month Spark-Delight entered Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: Twentieth year sixth month Mars entered Celestial Granary.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Severe starvation threatens.

translations.literal: On dinghai in the seventh month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Supreme Palace.
translations.idiomatic: July dinghai daylight Venus inside the Supreme Palace.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太白入太微，國有憂。

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “When the Great White enters the Supreme Palace the state has sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: Venus inside the Supreme Palace brings national grief.

translations.literal: Appearance by daylight means armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Daylight Venus signals military bereavement.

sentences.zh: 」十二月己巳，月犯楗閉及東西咸。

translations.literal: On jisi in the twelfth month the Moon transgressed Key-and-Bolt and Eastern and Western Harm.
translations.idiomatic: December jisi crossed Key-and-Bolt and the Harm stars.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「楗閉司心腹喉舌，東西咸主陰謀。

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Key-and-Bolt governs heart-and-belly and throat-and-tongue; Eastern and Western Harm govern secret plots.
translations.idiomatic: Those stars oversee palace intimates and intrigue.

sentences.zh: 」二十一年二月壬申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On renshen in the second month of the twenty-first year the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-first year February renshen daylight Venus.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，太白連晝見，在羽林。

translations.literal: On guimao in the third month the Great White remained visible by day in the Forbidden Guards.
translations.idiomatic: March guimao prolonged daylight Venus in the Forbidden Guards.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有強臣，有兵喪，中軍兵起。

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be overpowerful ministers, armies and mourning, and central-army mutiny.
translations.idiomatic: Strong ministers, warfare, and palace troops arise.

translations.literal: In the third month the Great White was seen by day in the Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: March daylight Venus in the Stomach.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Central-army troops will arise.
translations.idiomatic: Capital armies mobilize.

translations.literal: On renwu in the fourth month the Great White entered Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: April renwu Venus entered Celestial Granary.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be famine.
translations.idiomatic: Famine follows.

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Year Star transgressed the Weeping Stars.
translations.idiomatic: June Jupiter crossed the Weepers.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be occasions for weeping.
translations.idiomatic: National mourning approaches.

translations.literal: That ninth month the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor died that September.

sentences.zh: 隆安元年，王恭等舉兵脅朝廷，於是內外戒嚴，殺王國寶以謝之。

translations.literal: In Long’an 1 Wang Gong and others raised troops against the court; interior and exterior armed while Wang Guobao was executed as apology.
translations.idiomatic: Long’an 1 Wang Gong’s coercion forced executions including Wang Guobao.

sentences.zh: 又連歲水旱，三方動，眾人饑。

translations.literal: Floods and droughts struck year after year; three fronts stirred and multitudes starved.
translations.idiomatic: Successive disasters and famine convulsed the realm.

sentences.zh: 安帝隆安元年正月癸亥，熒惑犯哭泣星。

translations.literal: On guihai in the first month of Emperor An’s Long’an 1 Spark-Delight transgressed the Weeping Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor An’s Long’an 1 New Year guihai Mars crossed the Weepers.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be occasions for weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Weeping occasions follow.

translations.literal: On dingchou in the fourth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: April dingchou daylight Venus in the Well.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have armies and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Qin faces campaigns and grief.

sentences.zh: 」六月，姚興攻洛陽，郗恢遣兵救之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Yao Xing attacked Luoyang and Xi Hui dispatched relief troops.
translations.idiomatic: June Yao Xing besieged Luoyang; Xi Hui sent aid.

translations.literal: That winter Yao Chang died; his son Yao Xing succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Winter buried Yao Chang; his heir Yao Xing ascended the throne.

translations.literal: Prince Wei Gui assumed kingship at Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoba Gui enthroned Wei at Zhongshan.

translations.literal: That eighth month Spark-Delight guarded the Well’s Battle-Axe.
translations.idiomatic: August Mars stationed on the Well axe.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers face execution.

sentences.zh: 」二年六月戊辰，攝提移度失常。

translations.literal: On wuchen in the sixth month of the second year Sheti shifted irregularly.
translations.idiomatic: Second year June wuchen saw Sheti astride unusual motion.

sentences.zh: 歲星晝見，在胃，兗州分野。

translations.literal: The Year Star appeared by day in the Stomach—Yanzhou’s field.
translations.idiomatic: Daylight Jupiter in Stomach matched Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 是年六月，郗恢遣鄭啟方等以萬人伐慕容寶於滑臺，敗而還。

translations.literal: That June Xi Hui sent Zheng Qifang with ten thousand troops against Murong Bao at Huatai and returned defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Hui’s Huatai expedition against Murong Bao failed.

translations.literal: Intercalary month daylight Venus shone in the Forbidden Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Leap month daylight Venus in palace guards.

translations.literal: On dingchou the Moon transgressed the eastern Upper Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Dingchou crossed the eastern Upper Minister.

sentences.zh: 三年五月辛酉，月又奄東上相。

translations.literal: On xinyou in the fifth month of the third year the Moon again occulted the eastern Upper Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Third year fifth month xinyou occulted the eastern Upper Minister.

translations.literal: On xinwei the Dawn Star transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: Xinwei Mercury crossed Regulus.

translations.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.
translations.idiomatic: Same glosses as above.

sentences.zh: 二年九月，庾楷等舉兵，表誅王愉等，於是內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year Yu Kai and others rose in arms memorializing execution of Wang Yu; court and camp mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Kai demanded Wang Yu’s head and triggered mobilization.

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year Luoyang fell to bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang collapsed to raiders in June year three.

sentences.zh: 桓玄破荊州，雍州殺殷仲堪等。

translations.literal: Huan Xuan seized Jingzhou while Yongzhou executed Yin Zhongkan and others.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan broke Jingzhou; Yin Zhongkan died in Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 孫恩聚眾攻沒會稽，殺內史。

translations.literal: Sun En gathered hosts, seized Kuaiji, and killed the interior governor.
translations.idiomatic: Sun En took Kuaiji and slew its governor.

sentences.zh: 四年六月辛酉，月犯哭泣星。

translations.literal: On xinyou in the sixth month of the fourth year the Moon transgressed the Weeping Stars.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year June xinyou lunar Weepers transit.

translations.literal: In the fifth year’s first month the Great White was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year New Year daylight Venus.

sentences.zh: 自去年十二月在斗晝見，至於是月乙卯。

translations.literal: From the twelfth month of the previous year it had been visible by day in the Dipper until yimao of this month.
translations.idiomatic: Daylight Venus lingered in the Dipper from last December through this yimao.

translations.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Calamity lies in Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Archives map the sign to Wu-Yue.

translations.literal: On guihai in the seventh month the Great Horn star scattered, flickering in five colors.
translations.idiomatic: July guihai saw Arcturus flare in five hues.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The king will be scattered and lost.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign scatters in exile.

translations.literal: On dingmao the Moon transgressed Celestial Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Dingmao crossed Celestial Pass.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “The king will suffer.
translations.idiomatic: The ruler grieves.

sentences.zh: 」九月庚子，熒惑犯少微，又守之。

translations.literal: On gengzi in the ninth month Spark-Delight transgressed and then stationed at Lesser Office.
translations.idiomatic: September gengzi Mars hit and camped on Lesser Office.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Recluses will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Hermits face execution.

translations.literal: On jiazi in the tenth month the Moon transgressed the eastern Secondary Minister.
translations.idiomatic: October jiazi crossed the eastern Secondary Minister.

sentences.zh: 其年七月，太皇太后李氏崩。

translations.literal: That seventh month Grand Empress Dowager Li died.
translations.idiomatic: July buried Grand Empress Dowager Li.

sentences.zh: 十月，妖賊大破高雅之于餘姚，死者十七八。

translations.literal: In the tenth month spirit-bandits shattered Gao Yazhi at Yuyao with seventy or eighty percent casualties.
translations.idiomatic: October bandits annihilated Gao Yazhi at Yuyao.

sentences.zh: 五年，孫恩攻侵郡縣，殺內史，至京口，進軍蒲洲，於是內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Sun En attacked districts, slew governors, reached Jingkou, advanced to Pu Isle—court and camp armed anew.
translations.idiomatic: Sun En’s fifth-year raids threatened Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 恩遣別將攻廣陵，殺三千餘人，退據郁洲，是時劉裕又追破之。

translations.literal: En sent another column against Guangling, killing three thousand, then retreated to Yu Isle while Liu Yu routed him.
translations.idiomatic: Sun En’s detachments failed against Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 九月，桓玄表至，逆旨陵上。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Huan Xuan’s memorial arrived contrary and arrogant.
translations.idiomatic: September Huan Xuan’s arrogant memorial insulted the throne.

sentences.zh: 十月，司馬元顯大治水軍，將以伐玄。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Sima Yuanxian built river fleets to strike Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: October Yuanxian readied fleets against Huan Xuan.

sentences.zh: 元興元年正月，盧循自稱征虜將軍，領孫恩餘眾，略有永嘉、晉安之地。

translations.literal: In the first month of Yuanxing 1 Lu Xun styled himself General Who Conquers Caitiffs, leading Sun En’s remnant bands to hold Yongjia and Jin’an.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxing 1 Lu Xun claimed generalship over Sun En’s followers and carved out the Zhejiang coast.

translations.literal: In the second month the emperor in martial dress dispatched western armies.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor donned armor for western expedition.

sentences.zh: 三月，桓玄，克京都，殺司馬元顯，放太傅會稽王道子。

translations.literal: In the third month Huan Xuan took the capital, executed Sima Yuanxian, and banished Grand Tutor Prince Kuaiji Daozi.
translations.idiomatic: March Huan Xuan seized Jiankang and killed Yuanxian.

sentences.zh: 元興元年三月戊子，太白犯五諸侯，因晝見。

translations.literal: On wuzi in the third month of Yuanxing 1 the Great White transgressed the Five Feudatories and thereby appeared by day.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanxing 1 March wuzi Venus crossed Five Feudatories by daylight.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Among feudatories some will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Regional lords face execution.

translations.literal: On wuyin in the seventh month Spark-Delight stood in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: July wuyin Mars stood in the Well.

translations.literal: Spark-Delight transgressed the Ghosts and the heaped corpses.
translations.idiomatic: Mars crossed Ghosts and corpse-stars.

translations.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.
translations.idiomatic: Same gloss as earlier.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，太白奄右執法。

translations.literal: On bingyin in the eighth month the Great White occulted the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: August bingyin occulted Venus on Right Enforcer.

translations.literal: On guiwei in the ninth month the Great White transgressed Advancing Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: September guiwei Venus crossed Advancing Worthies.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Those recommended as worthies will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended ministers die.

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year the Year Star transgressed the western Upper First Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Year two February Jupiter crossed western Upper First Minister.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，月奄斗第四星。

translations.literal: On jiachen in the sixth month the Moon occulted the Dipper’s fourth star.
translations.idiomatic: June jiachen occulted fourth Dipper star.

translations.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers will be executed within three years.
translations.idiomatic: Within three years chief ministers die.

sentences.zh: 」八月癸丑，太白犯房北第二星。

translations.literal: On guichou in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the second northern star of Room.
translations.idiomatic: August guichou Venus crossed Room’s second northern star.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，歲星犯進賢，熒惑犯西上將。

translations.literal: On jichou in the ninth month the Year Star transgressed Advancing Worthies while Spark-Delight transgressed the western Upper First Minister.
translations.idiomatic: September jichou Jupiter and Mars struck ministerial stars.

translations.literal: On jiaxu in the tenth month the Great White transgressed the Weeping star.
translations.idiomatic: October jiaxu Venus crossed the Weeper.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，熒惑犯東上相。

translations.literal: On dingyou in the eleventh month Spark-Delight transgressed the eastern Upper Minister.
translations.idiomatic: November dingyou Mars crossed eastern Upper Minister.
